targets.rawSql: WITH snapshot AS (SELECT * FROM dashboard_depth WHERE venue_id = ${venue:sqlstring} AND run_id = ${run:sqlstring} AND symbol = ${symbol:sqlstring} AND (${mode:sqlstring}='Live' OR timestamp <= $__toTime) ORDER BY source_sequence DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT timestamp AS SimulatedTime, cast(source_sequence AS VARCHAR) AS BookCut, cast(source_timestamp_ns AS VARCHAR) AS SimulatedTimeNs, (cast(now() AS LONG)*1000-published_at_ns)/1000000.0 AS SnapshotAgeMs, state FROM snapshot

SELECT timestamp, run_label, state, cast(source_sequence AS VARCHAR) AS Consumed, cast(source_head_sequence AS VARCHAR) AS SourceHead, cast(book_sequence AS VARCHAR) AS BookCut, source_head_sequence-source_sequence AS PendingRows, (cast(now() AS LONG)*1000-cast(timestamp AS LONG))/1000000.0 AS ProjectorAgeMs, error FROM dashboard_cursor WHERE venue_id=${venue:sqlstring} AND run_id=${run:sqlstring} ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1

WITH clock AS (SELECT max(timestamp) AS last_simulated_time FROM dashboard_depth WHERE venue_id = ${venue:sqlstring} AND run_id = ${run:sqlstring} AND symbol = ${symbol:sqlstring}) SELECT timestamp AS time, best_bid AS Bid, best_ask AS Ask, (best_bid+best_ask)/2 AS Mid FROM dashboard_depth CROSS JOIN clock WHERE venue_id = ${venue:sqlstring} AND run_id = ${run:sqlstring} AND symbol = ${symbol:sqlstring} AND ((${mode:sqlstring}='Live' AND timestamp >= dateadd('h',-1,clock.last_simulated_time)) OR (${mode:sqlstring}='Historical' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp))) ORDER BY timestamp, source_sequence

WITH snapshot AS (SELECT * FROM dashboard_depth WHERE venue_id = ${venue:sqlstring} AND run_id = ${run:sqlstring} AND symbol = ${symbol:sqlstring} AND (${mode:sqlstring}='Live' OR timestamp <= $__toTime) ORDER BY source_sequence DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT timestamp, bids[1] AS bprices, bids[2] AS bvolumes, array_cum_sum(bids[2]) AS bcumvolumes, asks[1] AS aprices, asks[2] AS avolumes, array_cum_sum(asks[2]) AS acumvolumes FROM snapshot

WITH clock AS (SELECT max(timestamp) AS last_simulated_time FROM dashboard_depth WHERE venue_id = ${venue:sqlstring} AND run_id = ${run:sqlstring} AND symbol = ${symbol:sqlstring}) SELECT timestamp AS time, best_ask-best_bid AS Spread FROM dashboard_depth CROSS JOIN clock WHERE venue_id = ${venue:sqlstring} AND run_id = ${run:sqlstring} AND symbol = ${symbol:sqlstring} AND ((${mode:sqlstring}='Live' AND timestamp >= dateadd('h',-1,clock.last_simulated_time)) OR (${mode:sqlstring}='Historical' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp))) ORDER BY timestamp, source_sequence

WITH clock AS (SELECT max(timestamp) AS last_simulated_time FROM dashboard_depth WHERE venue_id = ${venue:sqlstring} AND run_id = ${run:sqlstring} AND symbol = ${symbol:sqlstring}), trades AS (SELECT t.timestamp, t.event_sequence, t.price_ticks*cast(i.tick_size AS DOUBLE) AS price, t.qty_lots*cast(i.lot_size AS DOUBLE) AS volume, cast(t.notional_tick_lots AS DOUBLE)*cast(i.tick_size AS DOUBLE)*cast(i.lot_size AS DOUBLE) AS notional FROM exchange_events t JOIN exchange_events i ON (t.run_id=i.run_id AND t.symbol=i.symbol) JOIN exchange_events c ON (t.run_id=c.run_id AND t.command_sequence=c.command_sequence) WHERE t.kind='TRADE' AND i.kind='INSTRUMENT' AND c.kind='COMMAND_COMPLETE' AND t.venue_id = ${venue:sqlstring} AND t.run_id = ${run:sqlstring} AND t.symbol = ${symbol:sqlstring} ORDER BY t.timestamp,t.event_sequence) SELECT timestamp AS time, sum(volume) AS Volume FROM trades CROSS JOIN clock WHERE ((${mode:sqlstring}='Live' AND timestamp >= dateadd('h',-1,clock.last_simulated_time)) OR (${mode:sqlstring}='Historical' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp))) SAMPLE BY 1s

WITH clock AS (SELECT max(timestamp) AS last_simulated_time FROM dashboard_depth WHERE venue_id = ${venue:sqlstring} AND run_id = ${run:sqlstring} AND symbol = ${symbol:sqlstring}), trades AS (SELECT t.timestamp, t.event_sequence, t.price_ticks*cast(i.tick_size AS DOUBLE) AS price, t.qty_lots*cast(i.lot_size AS DOUBLE) AS volume, cast(t.notional_tick_lots AS DOUBLE)*cast(i.tick_size AS DOUBLE)*cast(i.lot_size AS DOUBLE) AS notional FROM exchange_events t JOIN exchange_events i ON (t.run_id=i.run_id AND t.symbol=i.symbol) JOIN exchange_events c ON (t.run_id=c.run_id AND t.command_sequence=c.command_sequence) WHERE t.kind='TRADE' AND i.kind='INSTRUMENT' AND c.kind='COMMAND_COMPLETE' AND t.venue_id = ${venue:sqlstring} AND t.run_id = ${run:sqlstring} AND t.symbol = ${symbol:sqlstring} ORDER BY t.timestamp,t.event_sequence) SELECT timestamp AS time, first(price) AS Open, max(price) AS High, min(price) AS Low, last(price) AS Close FROM trades CROSS JOIN clock WHERE ((${mode:sqlstring}='Live' AND timestamp >= dateadd('h',-1,clock.last_simulated_time)) OR (${mode:sqlstring}='Historical' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp))) SAMPLE BY 1m

WITH clock AS (SELECT max(timestamp) AS last_simulated_time FROM dashboard_depth WHERE venue_id = ${venue:sqlstring} AND run_id = ${run:sqlstring} AND symbol = ${symbol:sqlstring}), trades AS (SELECT t.timestamp, t.event_sequence, t.price_ticks*cast(i.tick_size AS DOUBLE) AS price, t.qty_lots*cast(i.lot_size AS DOUBLE) AS volume, cast(t.notional_tick_lots AS DOUBLE)*cast(i.tick_size AS DOUBLE)*cast(i.lot_size AS DOUBLE) AS notional FROM exchange_events t JOIN exchange_events i ON (t.run_id=i.run_id AND t.symbol=i.symbol) JOIN exchange_events c ON (t.run_id=c.run_id AND t.command_sequence=c.command_sequence) WHERE t.kind='TRADE' AND i.kind='INSTRUMENT' AND c.kind='COMMAND_COMPLETE' AND t.venue_id = ${venue:sqlstring} AND t.run_id = ${run:sqlstring} AND t.symbol = ${symbol:sqlstring} ORDER BY t.timestamp,t.event_sequence) SELECT timestamp AS time, sum(notional) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp,event_sequence ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)/sum(volume) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp,event_sequence ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS VWAP FROM trades CROSS JOIN clock WHERE ((${mode:sqlstring}='Live' AND timestamp >= dateadd('h',-1,clock.last_simulated_time)) OR (${mode:sqlstring}='Historical' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp))) ORDER BY timestamp,event_sequence
